instructions: Move an oven rack to the second position from the top and heat the oven to 450°F. Rub the 1 tsp oil over the inside of a 6-inch cast iron skillet or a small baking dish.
Drain the corn in a sieve, shake it well, then pat it dry with a clean towel.
In a bowl, stir together the corn, 3/4 cup of the mozzarella, the 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp sugar, a pinch of salt and the 1/4 tsp pepper.
Spread the mixture evenly in the skillet and sprinkle the last 1/4 cup mozzarella over the top. This makes a small skillet, enough for 3 people.
Bake for about 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted, bubbling at the edges and golden in spots.
Let it cool for 2 minutes, then sprinkle the scallion over the top. Serve warm in the skillet.
method_notes: Every version is canned corn, mayonnaise, mozzarella and a little sugar, spread in a hot pan and baked until the cheese bubbles. Two Plaid Aprons bakes at 450°F for about 10 minutes with no butter or onion, while Beyond Kimchee first softens onion and garlic in butter and adds Mexican blend cheese at 400°F, so this follows the first and adds the scallion that Beyond Kimchee suggests. No version has 20 ratings (Two Plaid Aprons has 7, Beyond Kimchee 3), so the lead is a fallback.
